items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 20 at 1:55PM AKST until November 22 at 5:00PM AKST by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 40 mph with gusts up to 55 mph
expected.

* WHERE...Northern Bristol Bay Coast.

* WHEN...From 11 PM Saturday to 5 PM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects and a few
power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The strongest winds will occur towards Togiak.
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: High Wind Watch issued November 20 at 12:55PM AKST until November 23 at 9:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Southeast winds 25 to 45 mph with gusts up to 60 mph
possible.

* WHERE...St Lawrence Island.

* WHEN...From Sunday evening through Monday morning.

* IMPACTS...High winds may move loose debris, damage property and
cause power outages. Travel could be difficult.
items.instruction: Monitor the latest forecasts and warnings for updates.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 20 at 12:25PM AKST until November 21 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow. Additional snow accumulations between 2 and 6 inches.

* WHERE...Dalton Highway Summits, South Slopes Of The Central Brooks
Range, and Upper Koyukuk Valley.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The heaviest snowfall is expected along south
facing slopes, especially along the Brooks Range. Areas at lower
elevations, including along the Koyukuk River, are expected to see
lesser snow totals.
items.areas: South Slopes Of The Central Brooks Range; Upper Koyukuk Valley; Dalton Highway Summits
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Wind Advisory issued November 20 at 12:11PM AKST until November 22 at 3:00AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 60 mph expected.

* WHERE...Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp, including Isabel
Pass.

* WHEN...Until 3 AM AKST Sunday.

* IMPACTS...Gusty winds will blow around unsecured objects. Tree
limbs could be blown down and a few power outages may result.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...The peak of the winds for this event is
expected around noon Saturday.
items.areas: Eastern Alaska Range North of Trims Camp
items.instruction:
Winds this strong can make driving difficult, especially for high
profile vehicles. Use extra caution.

items.headline: Winter Weather Advisory issued November 20 at 11:43AM AKST until November 21 at 3:00PM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Snow expected. Total snow accumulations of 4 to 8 inches.
Winds gusting as high as 35 mph.

* WHERE...Central Brooks Range, primarily Atigun Pass.

* WHEN...Until 3 PM AKST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Near Atigun Pass periods of falling and
blowing snow could significantly reduce visibility to a half mile
or less at times. Snowfall will diminish Saturday morning.
items.instruction:
Slow down and use caution while traveling. Visit 511.alaska.gov or
call 5 1 1 for the latest road conditions.

items.headline: Special Weather Statement issued November 20 at 4:03AM AKST by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Moderate snow. Additional snowfall amounts of 3 to 6
inches.

* WHERE...Upper Kobuk Valley and the Western Brooks Range.

* WHEN...Through Friday.

* IMPACTS...Travel could be difficult at times. Snow could reduce
visibility below one mile at times.
items.areas: South Slopes of the Western Brooks Range; Upper Kobuk Valleys
